parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

- **true**: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error code is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.


- **false** (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, inbound or outbound rules are created.

parameters.name: EgressRules
parameters.description: The details of the outbound rules.

sub_parameters.name: Action
sub_parameters.description:
The collection policy of the outbound rule. Valid values:

- **accept**: collects network traffic.
- **drop**: does not collect network traffic.

sub_parameters.name: DestinationCidrBlock
sub_parameters.description: The destination CIDR block of network traffic for the outbound rule.

sub_parameters.name: DestinationPortRange
sub_parameters.description:
The destination port range of network traffic for the outbound rule. Valid values for a port: **1** to **65535**. Separate the start port and stop port with a forward slash (/). Format: **1/200** or **80/80**. A value of **-1/-1** cannot be configured independently and indicates that all ports are available.

> If EgressRules.N.Protocol is set to **ALL** or **ICMP**, you do not need to configure this parameter. Settings are not required because all ports are available.

sub_parameters.name: IpVersion
sub_parameters.description:
The IP version of the instance. Valid values:

- **IPv4**: IPv4.
- **IPv6**: IPv6.

sub_parameters.name: Priority
sub_parameters.description: The priority of the outbound rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. The maximum value of **N** is **10**, which means that you can configure up to 10 outbound rules for a traffic mirror filter.

sub_parameters.name: Protocol
sub_parameters.description:
The protocol type of network traffic to be mirrored for the outbound rule. Valid values:

- **ALL**: all protocols.
- **ICMP**: Internet Control Message Protocol.
- **TCP**: Transmission Control Protocol.
- **UDP**: User Datagram Protocol.

sub_parameters.name: SourceCidrBlock
sub_parameters.description: The source CIDR block of network traffic for the outbound rule.

sub_parameters.name: SourcePortRange
sub_parameters.description:
The source port range of network traffic for the outbound rule. Valid values for a port: **1** to **65535**. Separate the start port and stop port with a forward slash (/). Format: **1/200** or **80/80**. A value of **-1/-1** cannot be configured independently and indicates that all ports are available.

> If EgressRules.N.Protocol is set to **ALL** or **ICMP**, you do not need to configure this parameter. Settings are not required because all ports are available.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the traffic mirror.

You can call [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) to query the most recent region list. For more information about regions that support traffic mirroring, see [Traffic mirroring overview](~~207513~~).
